notes.title: 🤜🤛Setting Party Meter To 11 With This Quadruple CO-OP BUNDLE!
notes.content:
One thing about CO-OP games is that there’s never enough of them. With this bundle, we’re changing this and presenting you a combo of FOUR amazing titles to enjoy with your friends and family (and we’re doing so with a jaw-dropping discount)!

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398544/3e1e770fbccedf19ca28f386313250186849f762.png

[hr][/hr]

ABOUT THIS BUNDLE

In Ready, Steady, Ship!, grab a buddy and dive into erratic couch co-op action, use various tools and equipment to assemble efficient conveyor belts and keep the goods flowing smoothly. 

Then, switch to Lumberhill, as lumberjacks, race against nature to complete tasks. Fight wildfires, fend off pirates, and dodge annoying monkeys as you travel around the world and through time. 

Move to the chaos-filled fun of Tools Up! Ultimate Edition and renovate homes and outdoor spaces (includes all updates, content, and DLC for endless renovation madness)

Lastly, launch Servonauts and manage a servo (that's Aussie for "gas station") as impatient space travellers demand service. Wrangle wobbly pipes, set up refineries, and mix the right fuels to build space gas stations with peak efficiency.

This bundle offers non-stop fun with shipping, chopping, fueling, and renovating adventures. Gather your friends, embrace the chaos, and conquer these thrilling co-op challenges!


Wait no longer, grab your favourite snacks, invite your friends and get this bundle!

notes.title: Ready, Steady, Ship! Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239077/8b9faece3a1ceaaac039ca4b8287fc89bae7fa8d.png
Welcome Factory Workers!
Whether you’re a seasoned veteran who knows the rhythmic dance of machinery like a cherished melody or a fresh recruit eager to learn the steps, know that we are constantly working to improve the way our factory operates.

Today we are happy to present you with a few improvements and changes along with the NEW DIFFICULTY SETTING available for all!

Patch Notes - Version 1.1.0
Factory changes:

 Improved Forklift SteeringEnhancements to forklift controls for better maneuverability.

 Crane Mode ChangesAll cranes now feature ropes, making them easier to use.

 Box Physics TweakedBoxes are now more stable while on the conveyor system. Improved stability even when boxes are thrown around.

 Emergency Exit Mechanic UpdateEmergency exit is available only in the 3rd stage. To unlock the doors and exit the stage early, you need to collect at least one star.


New Difficulty Setting- Easy Difficulty
 Timer removed
Allowing players to focus on solving challenges without time pressure.
 Additional fixing time
Provides additional time to fix breakable conveyors.
 Forklift Mechanic Reworked 
Introduces forklift object snapping assist for smoother handling. When grabbing a pallet with the forklift, you can now click to snap it onto the fork, preventing it from falling during movement.
May our forklifts glide smoothly, our conveyors weave seamlessly, and our emergency exits remain accessible only for the most extraordinary of circumstances.
The Factory Management Team
